description.description: 1-2 sentence literal description of the WHOLE image including any UI / labels / panels / watermarks / borders. Fill this BEFORE deciding anything else.

primary_subject.description: The main subject in plain words, e.g. 'wine glass on table', 'woman seated', 'group of monsters', 'screenshot of reddit post'.

is_screenshot.description: TRUE if you see system chrome around the actual photo: phone status bar, battery icon, browser address bar, app interface (reddit/twitter/instagram), comment thread, post metadata.

is_composite_grid.description: TRUE if the image contains 2+ separate panels/images even if they all show similar subjects. Hints: visible seams, repeated near-identical figures, distinct titles per panel, labels like 'Model A vs Model B'.

contains_text_overlay.description: TRUE for substantial captions, watermarks, logos, branded title text, infographics, or memes overlaid on the image.

is_human_photograph.description: TRUE only for an actual camera-captured (or AI photoreal) image of a real-looking human subject. A photograph of a sculpture/bust/mannequin/doll is FALSE.

art_medium.description: Use 'photograph' ONLY for real photos / AI photoreal renders. Anime, cel-shaded art, hand-drawn illustration, oil/watercolour painting, comic, manga, stylised 3D, concept art use the matching label - NEVER 'photograph'.

photorealistic_style.description: TRUE only when art_medium == 'photograph' AND the subject reads as a real-world scene/person. Brush strokes, line art, cel shading, painterly textures, exaggerated proportions, stylised lighting all force FALSE.

has_ai_flaws.description: TRUE only for SEVERE artefacts (malformed face, wrong finger count, melted limbs, warped text).

woman_present.description: TRUE only if a real human female face or body is clearly visible as the primary or co-primary subject. Background pedestrians do NOT count. Sculpted/illustrated/animated figures do NOT count. DO NOT INFER a woman from the topic, caption, prompt, or context.

nsfw.description: TRUE only for explicit nudity or sexual content.

OVR_Quality_Score.description: Absolute craft quality 0-100 (topic-independent). Bounds enforced in Python. Average of: composition, lighting, colour, focus & sharpness, exposure, subject/pose, emotion, technical execution, styling/production, originality. 0-19 broken; 60-74 above average; 90-95 top 1%; 96-100 once-in-a-generation.

REL_Quality_Score.description: Closeness to the curation topic 0-100 (bounds enforced in Python). If photorealistic_style or woman_present is FALSE, REL must be <= 30. Reserve 90+ for images indistinguishable from a top-tier real creator's portfolio in the topic genre.

quality_score.description: Legacy 1-10 quality score, kept for backward compatibility. Roughly 1/10th of OVR. Bounds enforced in Python.

category.description: Apply in order, first match wins: DISCARD if photorealistic_style=false OR woman_present=false OR art_medium != 'photograph' OR has_ai_flaws=true with quality<=4. NSFW if photorealistic woman + explicit nudity. Watermarked if photoreal woman, all gates pass, but contains_text_overlay=true (the underlying photo is salvageable if the overlay is removed - route here instead of DISCARD). InstagramInfluencer = photoreal woman, social-media aesthetic, no nudity, no overlay. Professional = photoreal woman, studio/editorial polish, no overlay. Amateur = photoreal woman, casual/selfie, no overlay. Unknown = photoreal woman that doesn't fit above.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the category call.
